qa_pairs.question: What should be done with the connections of the left and right side members before drilling out spot welds?
qa_pairs.answer: Uncover connections of left and right side members, drill out spot welds, then lift off trunk floor plate complete with side members.

qa_pairs.question: What type of paint should be used on mating surfaces after straightening and grinding?
qa_pairs.answer: Coat mating surfaces required for spot welding with zinc dust paint.

qa_pairs.question: What distance measurement A is specified for overlapping when cutting the trunk floor plate?
qa_pairs.answer: Mark distance A = 20 mm (0.787'') forward from the marked line for overlapping.

qa_pairs.question: What should be checked in the area of the spare wheel well after grinding?
qa_pairs.answer: Check opening in area of the spare wheel well after grinding off cut flush with flange of the cross member.

qa_pairs.question: Where should spot welding holes be drilled for side members?
qa_pairs.answer: Drill plug spot welding holes in mating surfaces for side members. Also drill holes in flanges of side members through the trunk floor plate.

qa_pairs.question: What preparation steps are required before spot welding?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove scrap metal, straighten and grind mating surface, and coat mating surfaces required for spot welding with zinc dust paint.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done with the car before inserting the trunk floor plate?
qa_pairs.answer: Set up car on straightening bench, then insert trunk floor plate.

qa_pairs.question: What should be marked on the new part when installing cross member connections?
qa_pairs.answer: Mark location of cross member connections on new part from underneath, then lift off trunk floor plate.

qa_pairs.question: What happens when spot welds are applicable according to the note?
qa_pairs.answer: Drill out spot welds when applicable.

qa_pairs.question: What area of the new trunk floor plate should be cut?
qa_pairs.answer: Cut off new trunk floor plate in area of holes.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done after marking the distance for overlapping?
qa_pairs.answer: Cut off excessive metal after marking distance A = 20 mm (0.787'') forward from the marked line for overlapping.

qa_pairs.question: What component positioning equipment is specified for this repair?
qa_pairs.answer: A straightening bench is required to properly set up the car during trunk floor plate installation.
